item.title: October 22, 2026: Cold-Climate Inverter Heat Pump vs. 96% AFUE Gas Furnace: 3-Scenario Aux Strip Lockout Math
item.description: Counter-Intuitive Takeaway: In 1,500–2,200 sq ft homes, the $2,000 IRA Section 25C credit wipes out nearly the entire inverter compressor premium—making the heat pump cheaper upfront or breaking even in under 20 months, PROVIDED the thermostat locks out 10kW electric auxiliary strips above 25°F.
